## Publication review
- [ ] Only identifier-minimised research prose is included.
- [ ] No names, contact details, dates, identifiers, source links or clinic details.
- [ ] No raw charts, correspondence, pictures/video or metadata.
- [ ] Claims retain evidence labels; unknowns remain unknown.
- [ ] No diagnosis or causal relationship is inferred without verification.
- [ ] Filenames, commit messages, author metadata and history were reviewed.
- [ ] Changes were reviewed independently of the private archive.
